No second independent route description exists online (Mountain Project lists the line with no detail).

No source states a car-to-car descent figure for this route; the standing rule forbids setting loss_ft equal to gain_ft on out-and-back reasoning. 1,200 ft looks like summit-to-camp loss only. Would be settled by a trip record giving the total descent for the Remmel Lake / NW Ridge outing.

The route's own pins put the summit north-northwest of the trailhead. 'South' is wrong.
